fact: WHO terms of reference finalised on 15 April 2024 state that a WHO review mission of 28 May to 2 June 2023 recommended supporting the ongoing development of a national Digital Health Strategy with the Ministry of Health, so the strategy was still in development and not in force; they name the ministry's information technology centre (CIMS) as developing and implementing the hospital information system, whose medical subsystem includes the DMI.
title: Assessing the maturity level of the hospital information system in selected hospitals in Tunisia: Terms of Reference
